purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and prompt controls for a multispecies Matriarch succession hearing at a river-cleft archive grove.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for the terrace, ordinary witness labor, a returned route grievance, the succession hearing, and five authority outcomes.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use distinct scene anchors for the establishing view, joint-keeper office, each ordinary work choice, the folded rehearsal, the courier's pivotal arrival, each first response, the folded grievance, the public quorum response, and each ending. The courier impact and the elder's command receive separate replay beats.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base prompt supplies complete visible geometry, light, materials, bodies, positions, and props for a general image model. Character refs are assembled only for agents visible in that frame. Continuity notes remain tool-facing.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: luminous ecological science-fiction storybook illustration, fine ink contours with layered gouache color, dim mineral blues and fungal amber, precise readable nonhuman anatomy, wet bark and stone textures, quiet ritual composition, expressive posture, civic stakes carried by living infrastructure, cinematic interactive-fiction frame.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every prompt from global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for visible characters or groups, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Use the scene_set camera and staging slots as geometry authority. Exclude visual_continuity_notes from generated prompts.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture returns to one terrace from wide, medium, close, and downslope angles, and branch actions change roots, witness cords, route lights, roost occupancy, and shelter state. A draft map fixes those relations for review.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website rendering, build a plan-view or 3D blockout from the declared zones, camera slots, sightlines, and state anchors.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide elevated view of a crescent stone terrace above a narrow blackwater river cleft on an alien dim world. A colossal old tree with a chambered, scarred trunk grows along the uphill northern rim. A young tree with pale copper bark rises from a circular wet-stone basin at the center. Two rows of small amber fungal fruiting bodies enter through a western rock cleft and braid beneath exposed roots. A woven branch roost arch spans above that road. A low eastern wall is riddled with sugar cavities for a living ant colony. Several sealed root-and-stone gestation hollows line the downslope southern edge. Six-limbed reptilian-adjacent Airawa wait near nutrient baskets. A huge fixed companion planet fills the dark blue sky; its cold reflected light turns wet roots silver.

rooted upright in the central basin
two amber lines entering through the western cleft
small groups downslope beside nutrient baskets and sealed hollows

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable visual identities for recurring persons, trees, distributed actors, and groups. Prompt assembly includes only refs for agents visible in a frame.

characters.airawa_joint_keeper: Airawa joint-keeper: mature six-limbed reptilian-adjacent person with fine blue-gray scales, minimal slit-like nose and ears, grown shoulder and hip plates traced by faint cyan bioluminescent seams, two long strong upper arms ending in dark climbing claws, two smaller lower arms ending in clawless four-digit hands arranged as two opposing soft pairs, long digitigrade legs, four-toed grasping feet with hooked climbing talons, woven moss-green contract mantle with three separate cord loops, compact resin tools at the waist, precise lower-hand gestures and load-bearing upper-limb posture.
characters.elder_matriarch: Elder Matriarch: immense ancient tree with a broad chambered gray-brown trunk, deep scar seams lit by slow green memory pulses, buttress roots pushing through wet stone, layered archive bark, sparse dark canopy leaning over the terrace, root motion used as deliberate pressure and refusal.
characters.juvenile_successor: Juvenile successor tree: young Matriarch with pale copper bark, translucent green memory bands beneath thin outer bark, flexible rootlets filling a circular wet-stone basin, three cup-shaped receiving roots, one eastern warm shelter root, posture expressed through root opening, pressure, bark light, sugar secretion, and canopy angle.
characters.candle_fungal_road: Candle fungal road: distributed mycelial route visible as two parallel rows of finger-height amber fruiting bodies, braided pale mycelium, mineral threads, damp dark soil, beads that brighten, dim, or extinguish in sequence, material memory expressed through heat-colored tracks and bitter raised beads.

groups.threadwing_route_flock: Threadwing route flock: small gliding alien animals with narrow bodies, grasping feet, alert dark eyes, and wings formed from many long ribbonlike sensory vanes instead of feathers; vanes hold pressure, chemical, static, heat, and memory residues; body language uses vane spread, roost distance, circling, landing refusal, and coordinated launch.
groups.lattice_ant_colony: Lattice ant colony: hundreds of small dark jointed insects with pale microbial glue along their legs; they lock bodies into bridges, sheets, loops, and compact public glyphs; readable posture comes from lattice density, orientation, broken links, and the traces arranged beside them.
groups.waiting_airawa_households: Waiting Airawa households: mixed-age six-limbed reptilian-adjacent people with fine scales, faint bioluminescent plate seams, two clawed load-bearing upper arms, two smaller soft lower hands, digitigrade legs, and four-toed taloned climbing feet; each wears distinct woven bindings, carved plate inlays, fungal threads, resins, and pollinator-shell contract marks; they hold woven nutrient baskets and express pressure through talon rhythm, basket placement, plate glow, and upper-arm bracing.

review_notes: Narrative, lore-grounding, visual-continuity, and spatial-cohesion self-review verdicts are recorded in the training sidecar; all four accepted after targeted revisions.
The draft scene_set fixes one terrace layout across the multi-angle replay; a durable blockout remains required before high-consistency final image rendering.
All prompts use visible geometry, bodies, light, materials, and branch state rather than unexplained setting labels.
Visual review removed threadwing refs from shared frames where route withdrawal can make the roost empty; conditional modifiers now describe those bodies only when present.
